title: About Us
body:
**Friends Association for a Change (FA4C)** is a non-profit organization registered in Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh, India. Founded in 2011, FA4C was established by a group of friends who wanted to make a meaningful difference in the lives of underprivileged people in their community.

The organisation's motto — *Not for a Cause, But for a Change* — reflects its commitment to creating lasting, systemic improvement rather than one-off charitable acts. FA4C believes that ordinary people, acting together, can create extraordinary change.

Over the years, FA4C has grown from a small group of volunteers into a registered non-profit with five active programmes covering education, environment, health, women empowerment, and cultural activities. All activities are funded entirely through public donations and managed with full financial transparency via annual audit reports.
